title: metadata-protocol: an email-template locale added in a `<base>.custom` pair is read by name but never listed or sent, so a send in that locale renders the base's (#28779 follow-up)
body:
domain:server#2 · os-project-manager · session_0186vfjHHMsRXC9EUT9hTFMo

Filing gate: ① a product defect, measured, found by the #28779 dev at the seat's request (os-dev-report `6563592889`, PR #28800). Filed by `domain:server` seat 2. ⛔ Not a claim. Graded by this seat p2 under 「定级你可以自己决定」 (Leehom, 2026-11-01): a customer customization that saves and reads back but is never used, child of epic #28236's override line.

Reach: a customer who adds a locale to a vendor email template in the `<base>.custom` pair without `overrides` (admitted since PR #28777), e.g. `fr-FR` for `showcase_task_done_email`, which the base ships only in `en-US`.

## What happens (measured on the showcase, main `8f294e04`)

- The save and the publish answer 200; the by-name read returns the `fr-FR` body.
- `GET /meta/email_template`, `?package=<base>` and the execution list (`getMetaItemsForExecution`) do not carry it: the environment-wide list narrows at name grain to the one package that ships the name.
- So `renderTemplate(…, locale: fr-FR)` renders the base's `en-US`. The customization is read but never sent.
- The same list seam also decides what happens to a **dependent** package's added locale under a base template's name (#28779, evidence on #28390 `6563574978`): today the base address and the package-less read serve it, stamped with the dependent's id, while the lists and the send path drop it.

## Wanted (seat's pick: option A of the #28779 report)

Member-grain coexistence, matching ADR-0146 D2 ("a dependent adds items under its own names") and the ruling A recorded on #28390:
- the base address (lists, by-name reads, the execution list) serves the base's members, the pair's declared overrides **and the pair's own added members**, so a pair-added locale is listed and sent;
- a dependent's added member is served only under `?package=<dependent>`; the base-named and package-less by-name reads stop falling through to it.

⛔ Not option B (a dependent's member joining the base bundle: the silent-contribution shape #28390 reserves). Tests: a pair-added `fr-FR` is listed under the base and `renderTemplate` `fr-FR` renders it; a dependent's `fr-FR` is not served on the base address; the base's own `en-US` and a pair override of `en-US` unchanged. PR #28800's shape pin flips with this card.

Dedupe: searched `email_template locale list soleShippingPackage member grain`, `custom addition never sent`, `getMetaItemsForExecution fr-FR`; none.

Links back: #28779, #28746, PR #28777, PR #28800, #28390, epic #28236.
